setup:
rabbitmqadmin exchanges declare --name mail --type direct --durable true
rabbitmqadmin exchanges declare --name mail.retry --type direct --durable true
rabbitmqadmin queues declare --name emails --type classic --durable true --arguments '{"x-dead-letter-exchange": "mail.retry"}'
rabbitmqadmin bindings declare --source mail --destination-type queue --destination emails --routing-key send
